hero.title: I build software that solves
hero.tagline: Designing, building, and optimizing software end-to-end.
hero.description: I'm Julio Castro, a Software Engineering student at UPC and a Full Stack developer. I work with clients and teams to understand their needs and turn them into software that makes their work easier and helps them reach their goals.

about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I am an eighth-semester Software Engineering student at Universidad Peruana de Ciencias Aplicadas, with a solid foundation in programming, data structures, databases, requirements engineering, software architecture, and information security.
about.paragraph2: Throughout my degree, I have developed individual and team academic projects, applying requirements analysis, solution design, development best practices, and version control with Git. I have experience building web applications and collaborating using agile methodologies.
about.paragraph3: I complement my university studies with practical experience in full stack web development, strengthening both my technical skills and my problem-solving mindset. I am proactive, methodical, and responsible, with a strong interest in continuous learning and professional growth in software development.
